_comment: Gems: socketed into equipment (loot.json `sockets`, 0-2 per item) for a flat stat that is NOT scaled by the piece's quality or sharpening. Gem items are registered as gem_<kind id>_<level> (stackable). `values` are per level, strictly increasing. Upgrade: consume `consume` gems of one kind and level, pay `gold`, succeed with `success_chance` for the level being upgraded (steps[0] is level 1 -> 2); on failure `keep_one` hands one of the consumed gems back. Drops: per player per event; the chance grows with the key level by key_bonus_per_level (capped); level_weights are relative per level (index 0 = level 1). Tuned so a max-level gem of a chosen kind takes about 100 runs (see docs/gems.md).
